title: GurneyJourney App Now for Android
content: You asked for it, and it's here: The freeGurneyJourney Appis now available on Android. It lets you use your Android device to keep up with GurneyJourney blog posts. Please let us know in the comments how it works for you.If you're an Apple/iOS user,there's already an appfor your iPhone or iPad.GurneyJourney App for AndroidThanks,Dan!
